title: Template:Infobox character/doc
content:
==Description== To use this template, copy the following code and fill in the appropriate fields. ==Syntax== 
{{infobox character
 | title         = 
 | image         = [e.g. "Example.jpg"]
 | imagewidth    = [e.g. "150"] [default: 210 pixels]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | position      =
 | age           =
 | status        =
 | height        =
 | weight        =
}}
==Samples== 
{{infobox character
 | title         = Flowa
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | imagecaption  = Flowa, at rest
 | position      = Legal Secretary
 | age           = 2 months
 | status        = Active
 | height        = 5 inches
 | weight        = 20 grams
}}
Results in... {{infobox character | title = Flowa | image = Example.jpg | imagecaption = Flowa, at rest | position = Legal Secretary | age = 2 months | status = Active | height = 5 inches | weight = 20 grams }} [[Category:Infobox templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
